body:
[REPORT LIMITED — runtime.report_limited·report_name (runtime.report_limited·report) is out of provider capacity]
Its provider refused the turn on a usage limit, so it stopped mid-task and is now FROZEN.
Lane: runtime.report_limited·lane
Limit lifts: runtime.report_limited·reset_at
Provider said: runtime.report_limited·err

It is blocked, not broken — the work it was doing is held and will be replayed when it runs again. Whether it wakes by itself when the window lifts depends on this org's auto-resume setting; ▶ resume works either way.

You have NOT been woken for this, and you will not hear about this wall again: it is one notice per episode, and the next one comes only after it has run a turn and been walled afresh. If the work cannot wait for the reset, move it to another agent or another lane.
